_comment: Single source for the demo video: shot order, planned windows, on-screen captions and narration (docs/submission/video-script.md). make-stills, record-private and assemble read this file. Manual clips (shots 3-4) and their kept time ranges go in ~/formtwin-video/manual.json, not here.

narration: Every visa renewal, foreign residents in Japan copy their residence card into a Japanese paper form.
Those values are personal data — they shouldn't have to leave the device.
FormTwin uses Firebase AI Logic and places each inference by how sensitive the data is.
Public forms are analysed in the cloud. Personal data is read only by the on-device model in Chrome.
On the public side, Gemini in the cloud proposes field definitions for the official form.
A person reviews them. Only the adopted revision is signed and bundled into the personal-entry app.
Field explanations use hybrid inference: cloud first, and when the network is gone,
Firebase AI Logic falls back to the model on this device automatically.

captions.text: Network off (Chrome offline mode) · model already downloaded

narration: The personal-entry app is a separate site. Its security policy blocks network connections from the page,
and it starts only after checking the signed form package.
The card is read on this device.
The results are only candidates — FormTwin asks you to compare every character with your card.
If a card number does not look right, FormTwin will not offer it with one click — you type it.
Only values you checked are written to the form.
FormTwin fills the official PDF, with a font that tells O and 0 apart.
You save it, print it and sign it by hand.
Data lives in memory only.
Ending the session, ten minutes of inactivity, or leaving the page clears it.

captions.text: Fictional data only · not legal advice

narration: We froze our thresholds before testing and kept the result that missed them.
On-device AI helps; you stay in control of every value. FormTwin.
